_note: Single source of truth for skill steps and planned timing. Read by the Vue app (renders the steps) and by FastAPI/pytest (allowed skill ids + timing checks). The model never changes these steps.

skills.name: Paced breathing

steps.text: Breathe with the circle. In as it grows, out as it shrinks.

skills.timing_assumption: Fully paced by the app: 3 s orientation + 6 cycles of 4 s in / 6 s out. No user input needed.

skills.name: 5-4-3-2-1 grounding

steps.text: Look for 5 things you can see.
Listen for 3 things you can hear.

skills.timing_assumption: User taps once per step after noticing silently (no typing). Assumed 8-12 s per step.

skills.name: STOP

steps.title: Stop
steps.text: Pause what you're doing. Stay where you are.

steps.title: Take a step back
steps.text: Take one slow breath and step back from the moment.

steps.title: Observe
steps.text: Notice what's happening inside you, and what's happening around you.

steps.title: Proceed mindfully
steps.text: Choose your next small step, at your own pace.

skills.timing_assumption: Each letter advances on its own after the listed time; the user may tap Next to move sooner.

skills.name: One-minute reframe
skills.short: Look at one thought another way

steps.text: What makes it feel true? A word or two is enough.
Is there another way to read it?
You looked at the thought from another side. That's the whole skill.

skills.timing_assumption: User taps a chip or types a few words (15 s), types or skips evidence (20 s), picks or writes an alternative (25 s, includes up to 6 s model wait; model timeout is 6 s), reads the close (5 s).
